item.summary: Cache full api tests with FairAffinityFunction fail

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: With FairAffinity information about affinity assignments is sent as list of ClusterNode instances, ClusterNode has attribute 'isLocal' which is not marshalled. Implemented simple fix to initialize 'isLocal' attribute during GridDhtAffinityAssignmentResponse unmarshaling, better with for ClusterNode will be implemented in IGNITE-10.
